pipeline.note: Generation reused from the 2026-08-20 queue; every map was composed again on 2026-09-20 under the current height encoding and this review.

release.known_failures_note: These eleven ship. Each fails one rule, surface is too smooth for its material class, by between 0.3 and 27 per cent of a band the classification review itself describes as the pipeline's defaults rather than a per texture judgement. The five soil ones are the authored path's keep_mean clipping at zero and so lifting the mean it was setting; the rails, the torch and the grass top are near misses or a class derived from a footstep sound. Rejecting them would leave dirt, clay, podzol and rails with no maps beside neighbours that have them, which is a worse picture than the overshoot.
